no_subject_conditioning.description: Remove subject-adaptive feature weights; use fixed uniform weights

no_temporal_feature.description: Exclude temporal decay score from alignment objective

no_semantic_feature.description: Exclude text semantic similarity score from alignment objective

no_content_type_compatibility.description: Exclude visual-to-speech content type compatibility matrix

no_symbol_identifier_overlap.description: Exclude mathematical symbol and code identifier overlap features

no_sequence_optimization.description: Use greedy local matching without dynamic programming transition constraints

no_confidence_rejection.description: Accept all top-1 candidate alignments regardless of score or margin

no_graph_validation.description: Output knowledge graph without cycle checking, deduplication, or unsupported relation filtering
